## About
Brown's Auto Repair and Transmissions is on Louetta Rd in Houston. Transmissions are our specialty, from fluid changes and filter replacements to complete rebuilds. We also take care of brakes, engines, A/C, steering and suspension, and the routine maintenance that keeps a car on the road.
Our technicians explain the problems they find and the fixes they recommend, so you can make the call on your own car. Every job is inspected and tested before your car is returned to you, and parts and service are covered by our warranty.
We also run a second shop in Magnolia. Whether you drive a compact car, an SUV or a truck, bring it by or give us a call.

## Services
- Transmission service: From fluid changes and filter replacements up to complete transmission rebuilds.
- Maintenance service: Oil changes, fluid checks and thorough inspections to catch small problems before they turn into big ones.
- Tire maintenance: We look over your tires and recommend what will help them last longer.
- Brake repair and engine diagnostics: Brake repairs and engine diagnostics with the tools to find the problem.
- Engine repair: Engine work, from diagnosis through the repair itself.
- Steering & suspension repair: We make sure your steering and suspension are in proper working order.

## FAQ
Q: Is your work covered by a warranty?
A: Yes. All parts and service have a 36 month, 36,000 mile warranty.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes. The Houston shop is open Saturday from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM.

Q: Do you have another location?
A: Yes, we also have a shop in Magnolia, TX, on Lonesome Pine St.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Everything from a compact car to a rugged SUV or a powerful truck.
